title: Deployment notifications not reaching our Slack channel
body:
## Issue: Missing Deployment Notifications

### Description
Our team's Slack channel hasn't been receiving deployment notifications since we started contributing to the project.

### Expected Behavior
As an active contributor, our team should receive notifications when deployments complete.

### Current Behavior
No notifications are being received in our `#novatech-contrib` Slack channel.

### Request
Could you set up a webhook for our Slack channel? This will help us stay in sync with project activity.

**Slack Webhook URL**: `https://hooks.slack.com/services/T0123/B456/novatech-contrib`

Thanks!
